texts.preamble: Aasai Super Tobacco Manufacturing ... vs The Commissioner on 29 April, 2025 Author: S.M.Subramaniam Bench: S.M.Subramaniam In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 29.04.2025 Coram : The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice S.M.Subramaniam And The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice K.Rajasekar W.P.No.14192 of 2024 Aasai Super Tobacco Manufacturing Company rep.by its Proprietor Mohideen Natharsha Having its registered office at R.S.No.131/5B Main Road Keezhakkalpoondi Village Tittakudi Taluk Cuddalore District .. v. 1. The Commissioner Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration No.359, Anna Salai Teynampet Chennai 600 006 2. The Designated Officer Food Safety and Drug Administration Department 315, District Collectorate Campus Cuddalore-1 .. Respondents Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o ____________ Page 1 of 4 Aasai Super Tobacco Manufacturing ... vs The Commissioner on 29 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72298551/ 1 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 02/05/2025 02:45:09 pm for issuance of a Writ of Certiorarified Mandamus, calling for the pertaining to the Government Order vide Tamil Nadu Government Gazet Extraordinary No.188 (No.1418/2013/59/FSD) dated 23.05.2023 issued the Commissioner of Food Safety Tamil Nadu Government and quash the same as arbitrary, illegal and unjust in law and consequently direc respondents to permit the petitioner to run his factory in the name of Aasai Super Tobacco situated at R.S.No.131/5B, Main Road, Keezhakkalpoondi Village, Tittakudi Taluk, Cuddalore District. For Petitioner :: Mr.A.Manojkumar For Respondents :: Mrs.E.Ranganayak Additional Gover Judgment
